visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ list of expandable question/answer rows that initially shows the first 5 items and reveals the rest via a Load More button
visualCharacteristics.summary: Striped question rows with + icons; first 5 shown, Load More reveals the rest

contentPattern.summary: FAQ list of 12+ question/answer items (expand/collapse), with Load More
contentPattern.structure: one row per FAQ item; cell 1: question (summary text); cell 2: answer (rich text). Author every item; the Load More button is generated by the block when there are more than 5 items

reuseGuidance: Use for long FAQ lists that should be progressively revealed. For short accordions without progressive reveal use the base accordion block.
